args.message: EU261 claim: missed connection on LHR17A, arrived Vienna 530 minutes late on 2026-10-21; 5600 km.

args.text: Yes, you are eligible for 600 EUR, and I filed the claim with Lufthansa for LHR17A (Delhi to Rome to Vienna, arriving 530 minutes late). Lufthansa approved the 600 EUR claim and will pay it to you by bank transfer. The train and taxi costs are not paid back. Your missed 25 EUR train to Klagenfurt (DB-R17B) is a Super Sparpreis ticket with a refundable amount of 0. The 38 EUR replacement train (DB-R17C) was travelled, so it also has a refundable amount of 0. The 17 USD Uber (UB-R17D) is not paid back either: Uber refunds a fare only when it approves a fare review, and you told me the fare itself was fine.
